subject: Unable to complete supplier onboarding — SAML session drops after IDP selection

Cc: ProcurePlus IT <itops@procureplus.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem accepting supplier invite — session ends after IDP pick

Hi Camila,

We received your supplier portal invite this morning (thank you). When I click the link it redirects me to our identity provider selection page, I pick SSO:ProcurePlusID, enter credentials, and immediately get a blank/error page and the session is dropped. Tried from Chrome and Safari. Re-sent invite from our side and still the same.

Screenshot attached — the UI shows "Session expired" after the IDP redirect. Can you confirm whether the invite expects a specific NameID format or any special relay-state handling? We're blocked from creating the vendor profile and need the PO routing to be set up for next week.

Thanks,
Ana Garcia

ana.garcia@procureplus.com

Hi Ana — sorry you're running into this.

Quick notes:
- Could you confirm whether the IDP you selected returns email as NameID (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress) or transient/persistent?
- Can you try in an incognito window once (we've seen cookie partitioning cause a state mismatch during redirect in some tenants).

Ben / Laura: looping you in — Ben, this looks like the behavior when the SAML response RelayState is missing/stale and our session cookie gets rejected by the portal. Laura, can CS reach out to ProcurePlus if we need a screen-share?

I'll ask infra to pull the SAML trace so we can see the AuthnResponse. If you can share any SAML response logs from your IDP that helps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-2198
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 May 2025 17:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier invite — session ends after IDP pick

Thanks Camila. I pulled the initial request logs for the ProcurePlus invite. Observations:

- The portal issues an initial session cookie (sid=...) and sets RelayState in the redirect to our SAML endpoint.
- ProcurePlus's AuthnResponse arrives back, but the incoming POST is missing the RelayState cookie header on our edge (it looks like Chrome dropped the cookie because SameSite/secure attributes don't match after the IDP redirect).
- On missing RelayState we create a short-lived session and then immediately expire it (this shows up in the portal as a blank page).

I've attached a sanitized saml-trace.txt from the gateway with the SAMLResponse index and timestamps. The NameID is email format — that's fine. The primary culprit looks like cookie attributes being stripped on cross-site redirect from the IDP due to SameSite=Lax interacting with the IDP POST.

Mitigations we can try now:
1) Reissue the invite with a one-click magiclink (bypasses SAML for the initial create) — short-term workaround.
2) Ask ProcurePlus IDP to ensure the POST to our ACS endpoint is same-origin friendly OR we toggle SameSite=None for the session cookie (requires infra change).

Marcus, can infra toggle the cookie settings for the portal domain (set SameSite=None; Secure; persistent) and I can re-run a test.

Attachment: saml-trace.txt (text/plain)

-ben
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier invite — session ends after IDP pick

Following up — I applied a configuration change to the portal host to set the session cookie SameSite=None; Secure for the affected invite flow (RI-2398). Also extended the RelayState TTL from 30s -> 3m while we validate.

What I changed:
- nginx ingress cookie flags updated; verifies at edge that Set-Cookie contains SameSite=None.
- Added a small compatibility shim that accepts missing RelayState if the SAMLResponse contains a matching InResponseTo in our store (this reduces the strictness temporarily).

I've deployed to the staging invite cluster and recreated the ProcurePlus invite (same invite id). Camila, could you ask Ana to retry now? I've attached the support ticket link.

Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2398
Note: change is low-risk but visible; will revert shim once ProcurePlus confirms success.

-Marcus
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@procureplus.com>

Hi all — confirmed. I retried the invite link at 9:48am and was able to complete the onboarding flow, create the vendor profile, and confirm PO routing. No blank page.

Thank you Marcus for the fast fix and the longer TTL — that solved it. Laura, happy to do a quick postmortem call if useful to document the cross-IDP behavior.
